content: In the closing section of the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk Ibn Turka argues that a person's fate may be learned from his honorific, indeed the fate of anything from its name, since titles of honour are heaven-sent and the letters associated with a person constitute a book in which his circumstances are revealed; he says he will end the treatise with an illustrative point that suggests the perdurance of this ascendant state (per MK's translation).
